Order: Fresh local catch from a scratch kitchen.

F.ad: Cocoa Village, Cocoa, FL
F.w: 2024 DiRoNA Gold Award of Excellence — one of only 16 restaurants in North America and the only one in Florida; DiRoNA-awarded since 2006; Space Coast Living lists it among the 5 best fine-dining spots on the Space Coast. Order: Steak and European classics; wine list.

F.ad: 200 Imperial Blvd, Cape Canaveral, FL
F.w: Brewing on the Space Coast since 1997 (28 styles); named Best Brewery in Space Coast Living's Best of the Space Coast 2025 readers' awards; Visit Space Coast listing. Order: Carib lagers, ales and ciders brewed on site.

F.ad: Titusville, FL
F.w: Titusville's destination microbrewery (2014) founded by two women, profiled by News 6 ClickOrlando; Visit Space Coast lists its lumberyard taproom with full kitchen and beer garden. Order: House craft beer in a renovated lumberyard taproom and beer garden.

F.ad: Downtown Sanford, FL
F.w: Upscale beer-friendly gastropub known for bison burgers; on Orlando Weekly's 20 essential Sanford restaurants and named by Orlando Magazine's Sanford neighborhood guide. Order: Bison burger; duck-lover's pizza; shaved-beef sandwich on smoked salt-caraway roll.

F.ad: The Exchange, Winter Garden, FL
F.w: Orlando Weekly readers' Best Winter Garden Restaurant 2025; the burgers-bourbon-beer concept won the 2019 Orlando Sentinel Foodie Award for Orlando's Best Burger and Best Brunch Cocktail at Brunch in the Park 2026; Orange Observer covered its Winter Garden expansion. Order: Bison/beef burgers with bourbon flights.

F.ad: 1021 S. Dillard St., Winter Garden, FL
F.w: Orlando Weekly review: fuses flamboyance with flavor and straight fire — "the chicken 65... is the best $9 you'll spend on chicken anywhere"; from the owners of Cilantro Indian Cuisine (Orange Observer).

F.ad: 139 N Central Ave, Oviedo, FL
F.w: Family-run Oviedo diner serving since the 1950s with an award-winning breakfast; on Orlando Weekly's list of classic Orlando-area restaurants open 25+ years; a local landmark. Order: Biscuits and gravy; blueberry pancakes (breakfast all day).

F.ad: 5240 N Atlantic Ave, Unit 100, Cocoa Beach, FL
F.w: Quinisha Bredwood's 'soulful seafood' kitchen (opened July 2020) — Space Coast Living's Best New Restaurant, a News 6 (WKMG) feature, and Chowhound's pick for giant butter-drenched Florida seafood platters. Order: Snow-crab clusters in garlic butter & Cajun seasoning; shrimp and grits.
